findings.location: Paragraph on God-given authority; Romans 13:1-2 quotation
findings.source_quote: “and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “damnation” with a Dutch term conveying condemnation or damnation, such as “verdoemenis,” rather than the less severe “een oordeel halen.” For example: “en wie zich verzetten, zullen over zichzelf verdoemenis brengen.”
findings.translation_quote: “en wie zich verzet, zal over zichzelf een oordeel halen”

findings.location: Paragraph on church leaders; 1 Samuel 15:23 quotation
findings.source_quote: “and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “stubbornness” as “hardnekkigheid” or an equivalent, rather than “ongehoorzaamheid,” which changes the stated comparison. For example: “en hardnekkigheid is als ongerechtigheid en afgoderij.”
